audit.why: 44.78% over 1869 games, packet chart is Garen on all seven rows, and both layers already agree — no chart edit needed.
Spikes are ordered Lvl 3-5 / Lvl 6 / 1st item / Late with four entries present; the level-6 and late entries carried a mechanical error, corrected under point 4 rather than reordered.

audit.whatIsWrong: Demacian Justice is called a 'percent-max-HP execute' and a 'max-HP-percent execute' in three places. It is a true-damage execute that scales with the target's MISSING health — the page's own spikes[3] already says missing HP, so the two contradicted each other.
audit.why: Kit flags on Garen R: trueDamage and execute, 400 range. The max-HP framing tells you resists or an HP item help; they do not, and the real rule is to stay above the threshold.
audit.corrected: whys[4], spikes[1].text, mid and wants.foe[2] rewritten to true damage off missing HP, with the 400 range stated.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing anywhere said that Decisive Strike breaks slows. Locke's whole kite plan is the Q slow, and Garen's Q removes it on cast in addition to the silence.
audit.why: Riot text: 'Garen gains a burst of Move Speed, breaking free of all slows affecting him... silencing them.'

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet defect flagged zero cooldown-sequencing lines, and it was right — every cooldown reference was 'once it is down' with no number.
audit.corrected: Real numbers written into dosFull[0].d and report[5].t.

edits.after: Level 6 does not save you — this is the opposite of most matchups. Garen's R Demacian Justice is a point-click execute whose true damage grows with your missing HP, so resists never save you, and his W blunts the burst you need for your own R Purgatory. Never fight below half inside his 400 ult range; if your commit fails through Courage, he simply executes you back.

edits.before: Garen dominates every trade — his W Courage damage reduction plus passive Perseverance regen shrug off your Q Ritual Nails poke, while Q Decisive Strike silences your abilities and lets him E Judgment spin you down.
edits.after: Garen dominates every trade — Courage's reduction plus Perseverance regen shrug off Ritual Nails, and Decisive Strike (8s) breaks your Q slow outright, silences you, and speeds him into Judgment before you can leave.

edits.before: Damage reduction on cast — your burst only lands full once it is down. Only commit once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Courage is 22s at rank 1 and 12s maxed — chip through the window it is down, and never stand in his 325 Judgment range.

edits.before: Track Garen’s Courage: Damage reduction on cast — your burst only lands full once it is down. Commit only while it is down.
edits.after: Track Courage (22s at rank 1): burst only lands full once it is down. Decisive Strike, 8s flat, breaks your Q slow and silences you.

notes: The missing-health vs max-health error on Demacian Justice was load-bearing: it implies HP stacking helps, when the correct rule is to stay above the threshold and out of his 400 range. Decisive Strike breaking slows is the other unstated fact — it deletes the kite plan the rest of the page is built on.
